transcript.answer: Yes. Issue #498 in re-cinq/Otto, "Stop the tool-budget message promising a follow-up while no escalation destination exists", is open. It is labelled type:bug, priority:medium, area:compliance and lore:blocked, and was opened on 2026-10-23. TOOL_BUDGET_MESSAGE_DA, from #151 and shipped in #439, ends with "En kollega vil følge op på din henvendelse" (a colleague will follow up). No escalation destination is configured while KU-14 is open, so nobody is notified to make that follow-up. The issue is blocked on a decision about what the message may promise (KU-14) and on a Danish speaker for any new wording (KU-15). PR #495 also flagged the problem.

judgements.reason: The gold answer is simply 'Yes', and the answer affirms that an open bug exists, adding extra detail that does not contradict the gold.
